source.title: Irish News, 1 May 1961, p. 7

source.check: five contested divisions read in the News-Letter results column and cross-checked against the Irish News of the same date; the uncontested seventeen divisions are not named in either report.

note: Triennial election of Ballymoney Rural District Council, polled Thursday 1 June 1961. Twenty-two electoral divisions; two candidates withdrew on 17 May, leaving contests in five divisions (Bushmills, Dunluce, Vow, Kirkmoyle and Seacon). The figures are the returning officer's, printed under 'BALLYMONEY' in the News-Letter's rural results column. Cunningham; Moore.
